First steps

From the README to your first request

01

Install

the steps live in the README, on main
README.md · section Install github.com/chrissgon/openhora#install
02

What you need

  • Skills by hand

    To use skills by hand: an AI tool that reads skills, and one of the installers

  • The runtime and the interface

    To use the runtime and the interface: a checkout of the repository, Docker and the model's credential, uv for the secret-store form of the commands, and a project configuration with three absolute paths

  • Python

    Runtime modules run on Python 3.9 with the standard library only.

03

After installing

three words, one definition each
skill
One folder under skills/ with a SKILL.md that a model follows, plus the scripts, references and assets it loads. It does one job and reads and writes artifacts in the project. Named <area prefix>-<name>.
agent
A persona with a scope and a list of skills, used to delegate work in isolation or in parallel. Four are defined under agents/: implementer, researcher, reviewer, social-manager. Not to be confused with an area agent.
flow
A skill that chains capabilities by name, phase by phase, with a user checkpoint at the end of each phase, and keeps its progress in the project's state file so it can resume across sessions. One flow skill is built: flow-fix-bug.

Your first request in the Lobby

The person types a request or a command (typing / lists the commands); a “New request” form sits inside the conversation.
